268.csv::233.source_text:
《ハイデル地下霊廟》へ挑むのだな
なら貴君に深部の調査を頼めないだろうか
268.csv::233.translated_text:
So you're heading to the *Heidel Underground Mausoleum*, are you?
In that case, could I ask you to investigate its deepest depths?
268.csv::233.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::235.source_text:
あそこにこそ、疫病の原因があるのでは
ないかとわたしは踏んでいるのだ
268.csv::235.translated_text:
I suspect that the cause of the epidemic
may well lie right there.
268.csv::235.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::236.source_text:
実は、過去に村である事件が起きてな――
それと深く関わるのが、ハイデル教会の
司祭だったのだ
268.csv::236.translated_text:
Actually, there was an incident in the village a while back—
and the person deeply involved in it
was the priest at the Heidel Church.
268.csv::236.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::237.source_text:
もうひとつ、奥にハイデルにとって脅威となりうる
危険な魔物がいればその対処も頼みたい
268.csv::237.translated_text:
Also, if there’s another dangerous monster further inside that could pose a threat to Heidel,
I’d like you to take care of that as well.
268.csv::237.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::238.source_text:
霊廟調査を成し得たならば、
貴君の名声はさらに広まると保証しよう
よろしく頼む
268.csv::238.translated_text:
If you succeed in investigating the mausoleum,
I guarantee your reputation will spread even further.
I’m counting on you.
268.csv::238.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::239.source_text:
――おお、《ハイデル地下霊廟》を調査して
くれたのだな！
様子はどうだった？
268.csv::239.translated_text:
――Oh, so you investigated
the *Heidel Underground Mausoleum*!
How did it go?
268.csv::239.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::240.source_text:
――なんと、潜んでいた魔物を退治して
くれたのだな。感謝する
そしてそうか――霊廟の深部は
さらに別の封印が施されていたというのか
268.csv::240.translated_text:
――So, you actually defeated
the monster that was lurking there. I’m grateful.
And so—are you saying that deep within the mausoleum,
there was yet another seal in place?
268.csv::240.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::241.source_text:
分かった、わたしのほうでも霊廟深部について
引き続き調べてみよう
268.csv::241.translated_text:
Okay, I'll keep looking into the depths of the mausoleum
on my end, too.
268.csv::241.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::242.source_text:
古いエリアマスターが閉ざした場所ならば
記録がどこかに残っているかもしれん
手掛かりがつかめれば、また連絡しよう
268.csv::242.translated_text:
If it's a place that the old Area Master sealed off,
there might be some records left somewhere.
If I find any clues, I'll get back to you.
268.csv::242.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::243.source_text:
そうそう、最後にもうひとつ
《エリア情報》のことでいい報せがある
後でもう一度その件で話しかけてくれ
268.csv::243.translated_text:
Oh, right, one more thing—
I have some good news about *Area Info*.
Please come talk to me about it again later.
268.csv::243.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::244.source_text:
おお、そう言えば貴君
《ハイデル地下霊廟》の調査の方はどうだ？
268.csv::244.translated_text:
Oh, come to think of it, how’s your
investigation into the *Heidel Underground Mausoleum* coming along?
268.csv::244.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::245.source_text:
急ぐ必要はない、貴君の任務の合間を見て
対応してくれれば十分だ
268.csv::245.translated_text:
There's no need to rush; just handle this
whenever you have a moment between your other tasks.
268.csv::245.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::246.source_text:
疫病の原因調査は、これまでに多くの
覚者が挑んだが、未だ解決には遠い
くれぐれも身の安全を第一にしてくれ
268.csv::246.translated_text:
Many
enlightened beings have attempted to investigate the cause of this epidemic, but a solution is still far off.
Please, above all, put your own safety first.
268.csv::246.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::247.source_text:
では、《ハイデル地下霊廟　深部》調査の前に
手帳から得た情報を話しておこう
268.csv::247.translated_text:
So, before we begin our investigation of the *Heidel Underground Mausoleum: Depths*,
let me share the information I gathered from my notebook.
268.csv::247.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::248.source_text:
《開かずの路》で見つけた
先代の手帳には、例の事件の詳細が
記されていたのだ
268.csv::248.translated_text:
I found it in *The Road That Never Opens*.
My father’s old notebook contained
details of that incident.
268.csv::248.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::249.source_text:
どうも村人に邪教崇拝と糾弾されていたのは
司祭メンヴィル本人ではなく、その妻だったそうだ
否定したが迫害に耐えられず
妻は自ら命を絶ってしまった
268.csv::249.translated_text:
Apparently, it wasn’t Priest Menville himself who was accused by the villagers of worshipping a cult,
but his wife.
Although she denied the charges, she couldn’t bear the persecution,
and she took her own life.
268.csv::249.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::250.source_text:
その直後に司祭は姿を消した――
呪いの言葉を残し、霊廟の奥へとな
268.csv::250.translated_text:
Immediately after that, the priest vanished—
leaving behind a curse, he disappeared into the depths of the mausoleum
268.csv::250.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::251.source_text:
先代はその件に深く関わっていた
司祭を追い、復讐を恐れて
霊廟深部を封鎖したのだ
268.csv::251.translated_text:
My predecessor was deeply involved in that matter.
Fearing the priest’s pursuit and seeking revenge,
he sealed off the deepest part of the mausoleum.
268.csv::251.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::252.source_text:
女を死なせ、司祭を生きたまま閉じ込めた
後ろめたさからか、手帳にはこうあったよ
268.csv::252.translated_text:
He killed the woman and locked the priest away alive.
Maybe out of guilt, this is what was written in his notebook:
268.csv::252.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::253.source_text: "後世に、私達の罪を遺すことを許してほしい 勇気ある者よ、もしあの男がテルに 災いをもたらした時は、どうか――"
268.csv::253.translated_text: "Please forgive us for passing our sins on to future generations. O brave one, if that man brings misfortune upon Teru, then please—"
268.csv::253.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::254.source_text:
――面倒をかけてばかりだが、この通りだ
どうか貴君の力でテルの闇を
突きとめてくれ
268.csv::254.translated_text:
――I know I’m always causing you trouble, but this is how it is.
Please use your powers to
uncover the truth behind Teru’s darkness.
268.csv::254.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::255.source_text:
――そうか、やはり疫病は
司祭の呪いが元になっていたのだな
268.csv::255.translated_text:
"I see. So the plague
was caused by the priest's curse after all."
268.csv::255.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::256.source_text:
本来は、我々テルの住民こそが
向かい合わねばならなかった問題だ
268.csv::256.translated_text:
Originally, this was an issue that we, the residents of Teru,
should have faced head-on.
268.csv::256.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::257.source_text:
疫病が呪いからくるものであると分かった
だけでも収穫だ
原因が分かれば今後は対策について
調べることができるからな
268.csv::257.translated_text:
Just realizing that the plague stems from a curse
is a step in the right direction.
Once we know the cause, we can start
looking into ways to deal with it in the future.
268.csv::257.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::258.source_text:
貴君が霊廟の魔を払ってくれたことも、
おそらく呪いを薄める一定の効果が
あっただろう
268.csv::258.translated_text:
The fact that you drove away the evil spirit from the mausoleum
probably had some effect
in weakening the curse.
268.csv::258.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::259.source_text:
村を代表して礼を言う
力を尽くしてくれたこと、本当に感謝している
貴君はテルにとって、まごうことなき英雄だ
268.csv::259.translated_text:
I’d like to express my gratitude on behalf of the village.
I’m truly grateful for all the effort you’ve put in.
To Teru, you are undoubtedly a hero.
268.csv::259.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::260.source_text:
貴君にばかり頼ってしまって申し訳ないが
どうか《ハイデル霊廟　深部》の調査を
よろしく頼む
268.csv::260.translated_text:
I'm sorry for always relying on you,
but please take charge of the investigation
into the *Heidel Mausoleum: Depths*.
268.csv::260.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::261.source_text:
おそらくあの最深部にこそ
テル村を覆う病の病巣があるはずなのだ
268.csv::261.translated_text:
It is likely that right at the very depths
lies the source of the plague afflicting Teru Village.
268.csv::261.speaker: Alfred

268.csv::262.source_text:
――そうでした！
ワールドクエストに挑むことになった覚者さまに
お願いしたいことがあるんです
268.csv::262.translated_text:
――That's right!
I have a favor to ask of you,
O Awakened One, now that you're about to take on the World Quest.
268.csv::262.speaker: Seneka

268.csv::263.source_text:
白竜さまがお眠りになってからというもの
レスタニア各地ではさまざまな異変に
苛まれているんです――
268.csv::263.translated_text:
Ever since the White Dragon fell asleep,
various strange occurrences have been
plaguing all corners of Restania—
268.csv::263.speaker: Seneka

268.csv::264.source_text:
つい最近、西の《ブリア海岸》エリアマスター
オニールさんから、頼りになる覚者さまがいたら
紹介してほしいって神殿に連絡があったんですよ
268.csv::264.translated_text:
Just recently, Mr. O'Neill, the Area Master of the “Buria Coast” in the West,
contacted the temple asking if there were any reliable Enlightened Ones
he could be introduced to.
268.csv::264.speaker: Seneka

268.csv::265.source_text:
覚者さま、どうでしょう？
ブリア海岸の《ローテス村》に向かい、オニールさん
の用件を聞いてあげてもらえないでしょうか
268.csv::265.translated_text:
What do you think, Master?
Could you head to *Rotes Village* on the Bria Coast
and find out what Mr. O'Neill needs?
268.csv::265.speaker: Seneka

268.csv::266.source_text:
ああ、あんたが神殿が紹介してくれた
噂の覚者さんだな
来てくれてありがとう！
268.csv::266.translated_text:
Oh, so you're the legendary Enlightened One
the temple told me about.
Thanks for coming!
268.csv::266.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::267.source_text:
実は、今ローテスは厄介な連中に
目をつけられていてね
《ブリア宝奪団》って名乗る海賊まがいさ
268.csv::267.translated_text:
Actually, Rotess has been targeted
by some troublesome guys lately.
They call themselves the “Bria Treasure Raiders”—a bunch of pirate-like scoundrels.
268.csv::267.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::268.source_text: 連中は"ブリアの財宝"ってのを探してるようなんだオレに知ってることを話せと脅してきたり村人に絡んだりするけど、何のことかさっぱりで――
268.csv::268.translated_text: It seems like those guys are looking for something called "Buria's Treasure." They've been threatening me to tell them what I know and harassing the villagers, but I have absolutely no idea what they're talking about—
268.csv::268.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::269.source_text:
お願いだ覚者さん、力を貸してくれないか？
《ブリア宝奪団》と名乗る連中を
見つけ出して、村に近づかないよう
懲らしめてほしいんだ
268.csv::269.translated_text:
Please, O Sage, could you lend me a hand?
I want you to track down this group
calling themselves the “Buria Treasure Thieves”
and teach them a lesson so they stay away from the village.
268.csv::269.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::270.source_text:
あいつらのアジトは《隠れ浜》かもしれない
ならず者がよく出入りしているんだ
そのうち村が襲われても不思議じゃない
268.csv::270.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::271.source_text:
姿がないようなら、このエリアで
ボードクエストやワールドクエストを
しながら様子を見てみてよ
268.csv::271.translated_text:
If you can't find him, try doing
board quests or world quests
in this area while you wait and see what happens.
268.csv::271.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::272.source_text:
おっ、《隠れ浜》のならず者を追い払って
くれたんだな
ありがとう、どうだった？
268.csv::272.translated_text:
Oh, so you chased away
those troublemakers from *Hidden Beach*?
Thanks. How did it go?
268.csv::272.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::273.source_text:
――うーん、そうかぁ
すこし聞いてる感じだと様子がちがうなぁ
それはただの野盗かもしれないな
268.csv::273.translated_text:
――Hmm, I see.
From what I’ve heard so far, it doesn’t seem quite right.
It might just be a common bandit.
268.csv::273.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::274.source_text:
だとすれば、海岸少しいったところにある
あの場所、《海辺の地下室》あたりが怪しいな
268.csv::274.translated_text:
If that's the case, that spot a little way down the coast—
"The Basement by the Sea"—seems suspicious.
268.csv::274.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::275.source_text:
あそこは魔物や海賊がたむろしやすくて
危険だから封鎖したんだけどさ
268.csv::275.translated_text:
That place tends to attract monsters and pirates,
so we closed it off because it's dangerous, but...
268.csv::275.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::276.source_text:
またボードクエストや、ワールドクエストを
しながら様子を見てみてくれよ
268.csv::276.translated_text:
Also, try playing some Board Quests and World Quests
to see how things go.
268.csv::276.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::277.source_text:
おお、そうかい！
《ブリア宝奪団》を退治してくれたのか
本当に感謝だよ
268.csv::277.translated_text:
Oh, really!
So you took down the *Buria Treasure Thieves*?
I'm really grateful.
268.csv::277.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::278.source_text:
もしまた連中がアジトにいたら
逆にやつらの宝を奪っちゃってよ
あんたの役に立つ方がきっと宝も本望さ
268.csv::278.translated_text:
If those guys are back at their hideout,
why don't you go ahead and steal their treasure instead?
I'm sure the treasure would be happy to be of use to you.
268.csv::278.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::279.source_text: でも、"ブリアに眠る財宝"か――それが本当なら確かに気になるねそういえばブリアにはもう一つ村があったんだ南の浜辺の《ルフロー》っていう廃村がね
268.csv::279.translated_text: But “the treasure buried in Bria,” huh?—If that’s true, it certainly piques my curiosity. Come to think of it, there used to be another village in Bria—an abandoned village called “Lufuro” on the southern beach.
268.csv::279.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::280.source_text:
もしかしたら、例の財宝と関係あるのは
そっちの村だったのかもしれないな
268.csv::280.translated_text:
Maybe that village
was the one connected to that treasure after all.
268.csv::280.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::281.source_text:
恐ろしいことがあって一夜で滅んだって
話だけが残ってるんだけど、結局ルフローが
滅んだ原因は謎のままなんだよ
財宝と何か関係あったのかな――
268.csv::281.translated_text:
They say something terrible happened and it was destroyed overnight—
that’s all that’s left of the story, but in the end, the reason
for Rufuro’s destruction remains a mystery.
I wonder if it had anything to do with the treasure—
268.csv::281.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::282.source_text:
そうだ！　あんたなら、ルフローが滅んだ
真相や財宝も見つけられるんじゃないかな？
ブリアの問題を解決しながら、ぜひ
そのあたりのことについても調べてくれよ
268.csv::282.translated_text:
That's it! Since it's you, maybe you can uncover
the truth behind the fall of Ruflo and find its treasure, too?
While you're solving Bria's problems, please
be sure to look into those matters as well.
268.csv::282.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::283.source_text:
覚者さまならきっと《ブリア海岸》の問題も
解決してくださると思ってます！
268.csv::283.translated_text:
I’m sure that if you’re an enlightened one,
you’ll be able to solve the problem with the “Buria Coast” too!
268.csv::283.speaker: Seneka

268.csv::284.source_text:
どうか、《ローテス村》にいるブリア海岸の
エリアマスター、オニールさんの相談に
乗ってあげてくださいね
268.csv::284.translated_text:
Please be sure to offer some advice
to Mr. O'Neill, the Area Master for the Bria Coast,
who is in *Rotes Village*.
268.csv::284.speaker: Seneka

268.csv::285.source_text:
《隠れ浜》に最近、ならず者が
よく出入りしてるんだよ
268.csv::285.translated_text:
Lately, some troublemakers
have been coming and going a lot at *Hidden Beach*.
268.csv::285.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::286.source_text:
そこが連中のアジトかも
あんたの力で懲らしめてやってよ
268.csv::286.translated_text:
That might be their hideout.
Use your powers to teach them a lesson.
268.csv::286.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::287.source_text:
もし誰もいないようなら、このエリアの
ボードクエストやワールドクエストを
しつつ様子を見てみてくれないかな
268.csv::287.translated_text:
If it looks like no one's around,
could you please do some
board quests or world quests in this area
and see how things go?
268.csv::287.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::288.source_text:
少し行った所にある《海辺の地下室》に
誰かが入り込んでるみたいでさ
268.csv::288.translated_text:
It looks like someone has broken into the “Seaside Basement,”
which is just a short way down the road.
268.csv::288.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::289.source_text:
そここそ連中のアジトかも
どうにか懲らしめてやってよ
268.csv::289.translated_text:
That might actually be their hideout.
Please do something to teach them a lesson.
268.csv::289.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::290.source_text:
もし入れないようなら、このエリアの
ボードクエストやワールドクエストを
しつつ様子を見てみてくれないかな
268.csv::290.translated_text:
If you can't get in, could you please
try doing the board quests and world quests
in this area while you wait and see what happens?
268.csv::290.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::291.source_text: 【ヒント：スポット情報の見方】
268.csv::291.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::292.source_text:
採取アイテムや討伐対象の魔物を探すには、
エリアマスターの《スポット情報》が便利です
268.csv::292.translated_text:
To search for items and 
target monsters for suppression,
the Area Master's "Spot Info" is convenient.
268.csv::292.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::293.source_text: ①《エリア情報》から《スポット情報》を選択
268.csv::293.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::294.source_text:
②スポット情報で、「入手可能アイテム」と
　「魔物情報」を確認
268.csv::294.translated_text:
In the spot information, 
check the "Available Items" and "Enemies".
268.csv::294.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::295.source_text:
よしきた覚者さん、宝探しだな！
ルドルフォの爺さん家で見た古い灯台守の
日誌にあったんだよ、手掛かりが
268.csv::295.translated_text:
Yoshikita the Sage, it's a treasure hunt!
I found a clue in the old lighthouse keeper's
logbook that I saw at Grandpa Rudolfo's house.
268.csv::295.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::296.source_text:
南の浜辺の崖上にある《潮騒洞窟》は
当時は海神様の洞窟なんて呼ばれてて
お参りに行く人もいたんだって
268.csv::296.translated_text:
The “Shiosai Cave,” located atop a cliff on the southern beach,
was known back then as the “Cave of the Sea God,”
and I hear some people even used to go there to pray.
268.csv::296.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::297.source_text:
でも、洞窟は封鎖されたんだ
――それというのも、"海神様の宝"を狙って洞窟を荒らしたヤツがいたせいらしいんだほら宝だよ、財宝ってこれじゃないかな！？
268.csv::297.translated_text:
But the cave was sealed off.
—Apparently, it was because someone ransacked the cave, trying to get their hands on the “Sea God’s Treasure.” Look, this is treasure—isn’t this what you call a treasure trove!?
268.csv::297.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::298.source_text:
そういえば、よく分からない鍵が
引継品の中にあるのは知ってたんだよね
ビビっときて、もしやと思って
行ってみたら――大当たりってわけ！
268.csv::298.translated_text:
Come to think of it, I already knew
there was a mysterious key
among the inherited items.
Something just clicked, and I thought, “Could it be?”
So I went to check it out—and it turned out to be a huge win!
268.csv::298.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::299.source_text:
あんたならきっと財宝を見つけられるよ
その時は山分けでよろしくな！
268.csv::299.translated_text:
I'm sure you'll find the treasure.
When you do, let's split it 50-50!
268.csv::299.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::300.source_text:
――えっ！？
宝の正体は洞窟の中にある滝だって！？
268.csv::300.translated_text:
"What!?"
So the treasure is actually a waterfall inside the cave!?
268.csv::300.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::301.source_text:
はぁ～、でも、そうかぁ
洞窟の海神様――リンドブルムを
ルフローの人間が怒らせたせいで
村は襲われちゃったのか
268.csv::301.translated_text:
Sigh... but I guess that makes sense.
So the village was attacked
because the people of Ruflo
angered Lindblum, the Sea God of the Cave?
268.csv::301.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::302.source_text:
白竜様がお倒れになってから
海竜は急に凶暴になったらしいし――
以前なら、そんなことは無かったんだろうけど
268.csv::302.translated_text:
Ever since Lord White Dragon fell ill,
it seems the Sea Dragon has suddenly become violent—
I suppose that wouldn't have happened before.
268.csv::302.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::303.source_text:
――でも、本当に滝だけだったのか？
別に財宝があったりなんか――
268.csv::303.translated_text:
――But was it really just a waterfall?
Was there any treasure or anything like that――
268.csv::303.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::304.source_text:
――まぁ、しないか
あんたが言うんだしな
268.csv::304.translated_text:
――Well, I guess not.
Since you're the one saying it, I suppose.
268.csv::304.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::305.source_text:
いろいろ真相がはっきりしたのは良かったよ
そんなに綺麗な滝なら
今度俺も見に行ってみようかな
268.csv::305.translated_text:
It's good that the truth about all that has finally come to light.
If the waterfall is that beautiful,
maybe I'll go check it out myself next time.
268.csv::305.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::306.source_text:
覚者さん、財宝探しよろしく頼むよ！
《潮騒洞窟》にあるらしいからさ
268.csv::306.translated_text:
Hey, Enlightened One, I'm counting on you to help me find the treasure!
It's supposed to be in the *Shiosai Cave*, you know.
268.csv::306.speaker: O'Neill

268.csv::307.source_text:
金銀財宝か、すごい美術品か――
何なんだろうな！
報告楽しみに待ってるよ
268.csv::307.translated_text:
Is it gold and silver treasures, or amazing works of art?—
I wonder what it is!
I'm looking forward to your report.
268.csv::307.speaker: O'Neill
